subject: [RFC PATCH 44/57] mm/khugepaged: hold the address space open across a scan

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged code to hold a reference to the address space's mm_users count instead of relying on the barrier in __khugepaged_exit() and taking mmap_lock for writing. This change allows khugepaged to operate under a per-VMA lock, which does not hold mmap_lock, without causing exit_mmap() to free page tables prematurely. The patch also introduces new functions to check if an address space's owner has gone or if it is disabled from THP completely.
